title: Pet owners say smart pet feeder outage led to furry ones going unfed
summary: In a statement to The Verge , Petlibro CEO York Wu said this week’s outage was “related to how the Petlibro app communicates with devices through its online servers.” Petlibro first acknowledged problems on Tuesday at 5 am PT.
